name: manuscript_revision_agent_files_init
title: Manuscript Revision Agent Files
description: Invoke the manuscript-writing AGENT-file scaffold for a LaTeX IEEE paper workspace, keep AGENT.md immutable, install a bounded revision-response harness extension, and add REVISION_TASK.md for joint manuscript and response-letter drafting.

target_dir.description: Directory where the parent manuscript-writing agent files will be scaffolded before revision sidecar handling

mission.description: One- or two-sentence long-term manuscript-writing or revision mission statement passed through to manuscript-writing-agent-files and written into AGENT_GOAL.md. Required so the scaffolded contract is internally consistent on first read; must not include workflow preferences, current state, next steps, transient response-letter tasks, or transient objectives

objective.description: Concrete transient in-flight manuscript-writing or revision objective written into AGENT_PROGRESS.md. Must not define permanent mission, manuscript scope, policy, or success criteria. If omitted, the scaffolded AGENT_PROGRESS.md omits the Current Objective section entirely

overwrite.description: If true, existing parent scaffold files may be replaced by manuscript-writing-agent-files, and this skill refreshes only its own child-owned AGENT_HARNESS.md extension plus REVISION_TASK.md. If false, parent files are skipped only after manuscript-writing-agent-files compatibility checks, AGENT.md must remain immutable, the child harness patch is skipped only after compatibility checks, and REVISION_TASK.md is skipped only after sidecar compatibility inspection

patches_applied.description: Child-owned section patch names applied or verified, such as revision_response_playbook. Section-only edits are not reported as files_created.
